text:
support-jess: @ajay @maria customer AcmeDev reporting sudden 5xx spike after today's deploy (~13:45 PDT). Error rate ~30%, mostly 502/504 gateway timeouts. Escalating.

deploy-bot: deploy completed: rollout=r-2026-03-18-13:40, service=api-router, image=api-router:v2.3.1, seed_weight 10->100

ajay: looking. pulling logs and dashboards now — can you paste an example failing request id or response body?

support-jess: example from customer (sanitized):

```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
content-type: application/json
{"error":"upstream connect error: connection reset by peer"}
```

maria: on telemetry: traffic to route-tag "experimental-prefetch" jumped to 100% right after the rollout. That flag was supposed to be seeded at 10% but config applied 100% by mistake (config key: route.prefetch.seed = 100). This explains backend connection churn — prefetch kernel overwhelmed.

ajay: ok that matches. Action: pause rollout and revert the flag to 10%. @maria can you open the rollback/patch and I'll hold traffic and coordinate rollback window.

maria: creating rollback PR now — PR #4212: revert route.prefetch.seed -> 10. Applying to control plane.

sre-bot: action: traffic-control pause-rollout r-2026-03-18-13:40 executed by ajay at 2026-03-18T20:52:10Z

ajay: paused rollout. monitoring metrics — error rate trending down (30% -> 8% over 3m). Will keep pressure until PR applied.

ray: I'll draft a short status on status.redwood.dev and notify support-customer. support-jess — please offer AcmeDev a short-term workaround (switch to model variant "stable-prod") and capture repro steps.

support-jess: notified AcmeDev, they accepted switching to stable-prod. Sent them repro and ETA for rollback.

maria: rollback PR merged and applied. Config apply shows success; control plane reports seed=10. Gateway logs now show upstream connections stable. Quick root cause: a staging-to-prod config merge accidentally overwrote seeded flag value during the deploy job.

ajay: follow-ups: 1) tighten CI preflight to catch large seeding changes, 2) add a guard on configapply to warn on seed delta > 20%, 3) schedule postmortem doc. I'll open the incident template in postmortems channel.

support-jess: customer updated, they saw immediate improvement. Closing customer escalation after monitoring window. Thanks team :thumbsup:

sre-bot: incident-note: incident degraded 13:45 PDT, mitigated 13:52 PDT, follow-up assigned to eng/runtime and devex.
